Wang Ming Feng
Singapore | Mobile: +65 9228 4535 | Email: wang2042@e.ntu.edu.sg
linkedin.com/in/wang-ming-feng-161233265 | github.com/mfwang0906-bit

WORK EXPERIENCE
C22 × NTU veNTUre Programme | Data Analyst                                                                             Jul 2026 – Oct 2026
  – Engineered 17 pre-trade behavioural features from 46,500+ trades across 34 campaigns in a two-person industry project, preventing data leakage through automated recompute-after-truncation tests.
  – Backtested logistic regression and rule-based models using Python, pandas and scikit-learn; applied account-clustered bootstrap resampling and Bonferroni correction, translating validated findings into trading decision rules for C22.
Gotion High Tech, Shanghai | Electrical Engineer Intern                                                             Jul 2025 – Dec 2025
  – Supported three battery-system projects through component selection, two CATIA 3D wire-harness designs and reviews of 20+ ZWCAD electrical schematics; documented biweekly laboratory validation and safety tests.

PROJECT EXPERIENCE
Combinational Logic Circuits Learning Platform | Final Year Project                                                  Aug 2026 – May 2027
  – Designing a JavaScript simulation engine with parameterised decoders, encoders, multiplexers and demultiplexers, evaluating circuits across all input combinations.
  – Implementing procedural question generation, automatic answer verification and worked truth tables; deployed the static web application on Firebase Hosting with Git/GitHub version control.
TCG Price Tracker                                                                                                       May 2026 – Present
  – Built a Python scraper using Requests and BeautifulSoup4 to extract current e-commerce card prices, parsing nested HTML to distinguish multiple rarity and print variants.
Self-Hosted LLM Platform Odysseus                                                                                        Jun 2026
  – Deployed an open-source Python/FastAPI AI platform locally using Docker Compose on Windows 11 and WSL2, with Ollama serving LLMs through REST APIs; compared Qwen, Llama and Gemma models on an 8GB RTX 5060 GPU.
Biochip Biocomponent Characterisation | ML Engineer                                                                  Jan 2026 – May 2026
  – Applied KNN classification and regression to 500+ EIS impedance spectra across 20 biochips and four materials, achieving
  – approximately 60–70% classification accuracy.
  – Combined KNN with equivalent-circuit modelling to automate dimensionality reduction and remove manual feature extraction; fabricated 36 biochips and collaborated with the measurement team on source data quality.
Mean-Variance Portfolio Optimiser                                                                                    Jan 2026 – Apr 2026
 – Built a Python allocation model using Yahoo Finance historical data and 10,000 Monte Carlo simulations to map the efficient frontier and identify Sharpe-optimal portfolio weights.

SKILLS
Programming: Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, Plotly, Matplotlib, BeautifulSoup4, NLTK, spaCy), C++, MATLAB, JavaScript, HTML
AI and Deployment: Docker, WSL2, Ollama, local LLM deployment, FastAPI, Firebase Hosting
Tools: Git/GitHub, Jupyter Notebook, LTspice, CATIA, ZWCAD | Languages: English, Chinese

EDUCATION
Nanyang Technological University | BEng Electrical and Electronic Engineering                                          Aug 2023 – Jun 2027
Second Class Honours | Data Analytics and Machine Learning | Expected graduation: Jun 2027
Relevant modules: Natural Language Processing, AI and Data Mining, Image Processing and Computer Vision, Data Structures and Algorithms, Computer Communications, Digital Signal Processing
Shanghai Jiao Tong University | Semester Exchange                                                                       Jun 2025 – Jan 2026

COMMUNITY INVOLVEMENT
NTU Student Union | Orientation Group Leader | Aug 2023 – Aug 2024: Led a 20-member committee and 33 participants for a week-long freshman orientation camp.
NTU Hall 8 | Business Manager | Aug 2023 – May 2024: Coordinated logistics, budgets and sponsorship for three events serving 200–300 residents.
